`class ApngResourceFormat`<br/>

**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ApngResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/impl/ApngResourceFormat.java)

The built-in format of PNG files, still or animated (APNG).

## Description

A PNG with an animation control chunk plays as an animated image; any other PNG is a still image.

## Method details

<a id="ApngResourceFormat-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(byte[] header)` 

If `true`, `header` starts with the PNG signature.

<a id="ApngResourceFormat-method-decoder"></a>

### decoder

`IResourceDecoder decoder(Asset asset, byte[] header)` 

Returns an [`AnimatedResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/animatedresourcedecoder/) when the file is an APNG, otherwise a [`RasterResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/rasterresourcedecoder/); it reads up to 64 KB when the header is not enough to tell.
